_comment: Google Cloud resource types included in the FREE base pack embedded in the scanner — the types a typical google Terraform repo is mostly made of: compute, networking, load balancing, GKE, Cloud SQL, Cloud Storage, IAM, KMS, Secret Manager, Pub/Sub, Cloud Run, Cloud Functions, BigQuery, DNS and Artifact Registry. The paid full pack covers every type the provider ships (~1420) and is generated from the same source. Changing this list changes what the free tier covers: treat it as a product decision, not a data update. google-beta has no free base pack: resources that use it are skipped by the schema rules in the free tier.
